summary: Dynagas LNG Partners LP, through its subsidiaries, operates in the seaborne transportation industry in Greece and internationally. The company owns and operates liquefied natural gas (LNG) vessels. The company's fleet consists of six LNG carriers and three modern tri-fuel diesel electric propulsion technology Ice Class LNG carriers. Dynagas GP LLC serves as the general partner of Dynagas LNG Partners LP. The company was incorporated in 2013 and is headquartered in Athens, Greece.
